name: Crispy Chilli Baby Corn
subtitle: battered baby corn tossed in a hot garlic sauce, the vegetarian chilli chicken
prepNotes: Baby corn holds water. Blanch it and dry it properly or the batter slides off.
The batter should coat like thin cream. Thick batter gives a doughy shell.

steps.text: Blanch the baby corn 2 minutes in salted water, drain and dry thoroughly on a cloth.
Whisk the cornflour, maida, salt and enough cold water into a thin batter. Coat the corn.
Deep fry on medium-high until crisp and pale gold, 4 minutes. Drain.
In 3 tbsp oil, fry the garlic and green chilli hard for 30 seconds, then the onion and capsicum for 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, chilli powder, pepper and a splash of water. Boil 1 minute.
Toss in the corn, coat, and finish with spring onion.

storage: Eat immediately. This does not keep in any state worth serving.
